items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: there was a fellow by the name of Willy Berel. Should never forget him. He was working with the Tariff Show, the Toby Trophy Show.

ctx.x: Did you ever play on any of those riverboats?

No, never. I think the people who played on them were wonderful water logged (?). I went in another direction, you know. So, during that course, one of those nights, I thought St. Louis was New Orleans better. Why go to Stxxxxkxxxx? That's further south, it can't be any better. So I'm looking for improvement and not for any (yuk-yuk.)
